entries.question: Aaj neurology ki opd hai ?
entries.answer:
KGMU ki Neurology OPD somvaar (Monday), mangalvaar (Tuesday), guruvaar (Thursday), aur shukravaar (Friday) ko chalti hai. 

Aaj ka din check karne ke liye kripya yeh dhyan rakhein ki:
1. **OPD Timings:** Somvaar se Shukravaar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivaar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM).
2. **Holiday:** Aaj koi gazetted holiday toh nahi hai? Agar aaj holiday hai, toh OPD band rahegi.
3. **Booking:** OPD mein dikhane ke liye online appointment lena ya registration karwana anivarya (mandatory) hai. Aap www.ors.gov.in par check kar sakte hain.

Agar aapko kisi medical samasya ke liye salah chahiye, toh main ismein saksham nahi hoon. Kripya KGMU ke Neurology vibhag ya OPD mein jakar doctor se sampark karein. 

**Ek zaroori suchna:** Apni sehat se judi jankari, symptoms, ya personal details yahan share na karein. Suraksha ke liye, doctor se seedhe KGMU OPD mein hi paramarsh lein.

entries.question: Need opd appointment
entries.answer:
You can book an OPD appointment through the following methods:

**A. Online Portal (ORS):**
*   Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   Login/Register → Select State (Uttar Pradesh) → Select Hospital (KGMU) → Click 'New Appointment' → Choose Department, Date & Time Slot → Enter patient details → Pay ₹50 online → Download appointment slip.

**B. Mobile App (ABHA / Health Care App):**
*   Download the app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and verify with OTP.
*   Follow the same State/Hospital selection process as the ORS portal.

**C. SMS Booking:**
*   Send an SMS to 8887019134 in the format: "Appointment [Patient Name]".
*   You will receive a booking confirmation via SMS.

**D. Walk-in (On-Site Counters):**
*   Required: Patient's Aadhaar Number and an active Mobile Number.
*   Provide your details at the registration counter.
*   Receive an OTP on your mobile for verification.
*   Get a physical token.
*   Pay ₹50 at the counter to collect your physical OPD slip.

**Important Information:**
*   Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.
*   The OPD ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   The flat fee for an OPD slip is ₹50, regardless of the booking method.

entries.question: kgmu pharmacist me kya compulsory 20% female horizontal reservation k liye neeche waali female ko le lenge jinki rank 68 hogi aur ur male 18 ko bahar kr denge
entries.answer:
KGMU mein bharti prakriya aur seat allocation ke niyam **Uttar Pradesh Government ke reservation rules** aur **KGMU ke recruitment advertisement** mein diye gaye nirdeshon ke anusar hote hain.

Horizontal reservation (jaise female reservation) ka niyam yeh hota hai ki agar kisi category mein (jaise UR) niradharit pratishat (20%) female candidates nahi mil pa rahi hain, toh us seat ko bharne ke liye merit ke anusar female candidates ko select kiya jata hai. Is prakriya mein aksar merit list mein niche ki rank wali female candidates ko horizontal quota ke tahat select kiya ja sakta hai, jiske karan us category ke kuch male candidates (jo merit mein upar hote hain) bahar ho sakte hain.

**Aapko yeh karne ki salah hai:**

1. **Official Advertisement dekhein:** Recruitment ke samay nikale gaye official notification mein "Horizontal Reservation" ka clause dhyan se padhein.
2. **RTI File karein:** Agar aapko lagta hai ki selection mein niyamों ka palan nahi hua hai, toh aap **RTI (Right to Information)** act ke tahat KGMU ke Public Information Officer (PIO) se selection criteria aur merit list ka vivaran maang sakte hain. RTI se sambandhit jaankari yahan uplabdh hai: [https://kgmu.org/rti.php](https://kgmu.org/rti.php)
3. **Legal/Administrative Query:** Main ek AI assistant hoon aur official merit list ya selection process ke decision mein badlav nahi kar sakta. Agar aapko lagta hai ki aapke sath unfair hua hai, toh aap university ke administrative office ya legal cell se sampark kar sakte hain.

Kripya dhyan dein ki main koi medical ya legal expert nahi hoon. Aap sahi jankari ke liye **Registrar Office (0522-2253171)** mein sampark kar sakte hain.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.

If you are looking to book an appointment at KGMU, you can do so through the following methods:

*   **Online Portal:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Phone:** Call 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333.
*   **SMS:** Send "APPOINTMENT <NAME>" to 8887019134.
*   **Walk-in:** You can visit the OPD registration counters, but please note that pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

If you are a student or faculty member and have a specific administrative or academic inquiry, please let me know.

entries.question: Number lagana hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD appointment book karne ke liye aap niche diye gaye tareekon mein se kisi ek ka upyog kar sakte hain:

1. **Online Portal (ORS):** [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par jakar aap apna appointment book kar sakte hain.
2. **SMS Booking:** "APPOINTMENT <NAME>" likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhejen.
3. **Helpline Number:** Aap **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333** par call karke bhi jaankari le sakte hain.
4. **Walk-in (On-site):** Aap seedhe KGMU jakar bhi registration counter par apna Aadhaar card aur mobile number dikhakar parchi (ticket) banwa sakte hain.

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
* OPD ki parchi (ticket) ka shulk ₹50 hai.
* OPD counter subah 9:00 baje se dopehar 1:00 baje tak khule rehte hain.
* Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne saath sambhandhit vibhag (department) ka referral zaroor layein.
* Bheed se bachne ke liye pehle se appointment book karna behtar rehta hai.

Main ek AI assistant hoon, isliye agar aapko koi medical samasya hai, toh kripya doctor se sampark karein. Main medical salah (diagnosis/treatment) nahi de sakta. Kripya is chat mein apni koi bhi medical report ya personal jankari share na karein. Apni sehat ke liye seedhe KGMU OPD jayein ya doctor se paramarsh lein.

entries.question: Nursing officer exam date
entries.answer:
For information regarding the Nursing Officer examination dates, please visit the official KGMU notice board at the following link: https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php

If you are unable to find the specific schedule there, I recommend checking the "Recruitment" or "Careers" section on the main website at www.kgmu.org, as all official examination announcements are published through those channels.

entries.question: mujhe job ke liye aply karna hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein jobs aur vacancies ki jaankari ke liye aap humari official website par "Career" ya "Recruitment" section check kar sakte hain.

Aap yahan click karke latest notifications dekh sakte hain: [https://www.kgmu.org/](https://www.kgmu.org/)

Agar aap kisi specific post (jaise faculty, nursing, ya administrative) ke liye puchna chahte hain, toh please batayein taaki main aapko sahi link ya process bata sakoon.

entries.question: hrf me koi nikli hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein kisi bhi naye recruitment ya vacancy ki jaankari ke liye aapko official website ke **"Recruitment"** section ko regularly check karna chahiye.

Aap is link par jakar latest notifications dekh sakte hain: [https://www.kgmu.org/recruitment.php](https://www.kgmu.org/recruitment.php)

"HRF" (Human Resource/Recruitment) se sambandhit koi bhi adhikarik jaankari sirf isi page par update ki jati hai. Aap wahan jakar PDF notices check kar sakte hain ki aapke liye koi suitable vacancy hai ya nahi.

entries.question: Mujhe ye jaana hai ki filhal koi nursing ki conferences hui hai KGMU main
entries.answer:
KGMU mein nursing se sambandhit ek pramukh conference "Virtual National Nursing Conference 2021" aayojit ki gayi thi, jiska vishay tha: **"Nurses in Health Care Leadership"**.

Aap is conference ka brochure yahan dekh sakte hain: [Conference Brochure](https://kgmu.org/download/conference_brochure_kgmu_nursing_conference.pdf)

Yadi aap kisi haal hi mein hui ya aane wali nayi conference ke baare mein jaankari chahte hain, toh kripya KGMU ki official website [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org) par "Notice Board" section check karein ya PRO office se sampark karein.

entries.question: Supplementary exam
entries.answer:

Please visit the official KGMU result portal at [https://kgmu.org/kgmu_result/examination_result.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_result/examination_result.php), select your course from the dropdown menu, and choose the "Supplementary" option if available.

entries.question: Can I apply for KGMU nursing tutor post after bsc nursing
entries.answer:
To provide you with the most accurate information regarding recruitment, please note that KGMU generally follows the guidelines set by the university and the Indian Nursing Council (INC) for faculty positions.

Typically, for the post of a Nursing Tutor, a **B.Sc. Nursing degree** is the minimum educational qualification. However, recruitment criteria—such as requirements for clinical experience, registration with the State Nursing Council, and the specific terms of the vacancy—are defined in the **official advertisement** released by KGMU at the time of recruitment.

To stay updated on current or upcoming opportunities, please monitor these resources:

1.  **Official Recruitment Page:** [https://www.kgmu.org/job_opportunity.php](https://www.kgmu.org/job_opportunity.php)
2.  **General Website:** [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org)

I recommend checking the "Job Opportunity" section regularly. If an advertisement is currently active, it will contain the detailed eligibility criteria, application process, and required documents.

entries.question: I am bsc nursing student and I want to als and bls
entries.answer:
As a nursing student, you can enroll in BLS (Basic Life Support) and ALS (Advanced Life Support) training programs conducted at KGMU. These courses are typically managed by the Department of Anaesthesiology and Critical Care.

For information on upcoming training schedules, batch availability, and registration procedures, please contact the **BLS+ACLS Co-Ordinator, Dr. Rajni Gupta** (Department of Anaesthesiology and Critical Care).

You can also visit the **Centre for Advanced Skills Development** page on the KGMU website for more details: [https://kgmu.org/atls.php](https://kgmu.org/atls.php)

Additionally, it is recommended to visit the Department of Anaesthesiology office or the Dean's office to inquire about specific student training sessions.

entries.question: Where to apply for bds externship interview
entries.answer:
To apply for a BDS externship or to inquire about interview procedures at King George's Medical University, please follow these steps:

1.  **Check the Official Website:** Visit [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) and navigate to the "Courses & Admission" section or the specific Dental Department page you are interested in.
2.  **Contact the Department:** Externships are typically handled at the department level. You can find the contact information for the various Dental Departments (such as Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery, Orthodontics, Prosthodontics, etc.) on the [Department page](https://www.kgmu.org/department.php).
3.  **Administrative Inquiry:** You may contact the Registrar’s Office at **0522-2253171** or the Dean’s Office to inquire about the current process and documentation required for an externship application.
4.  **PRO Office:** You can also contact the Public Relations Office (PRO) for guidance on departmental procedures at [https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php](https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php).

I recommend preparing your CV and a formal cover letter addressed to the Head of the Department (HOD) of the specific specialty you wish to pursue.
